title: Quaintly Charred American Noodles Bake
description: A nostalgic American dish featuring flat rice noodles with a charred, shattering crust, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the flat rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked noodles, the meat and sauce mixture, and the shredded cheddar cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is charred and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
